meta.posture: Emergency floor (fallback + slot templates + fully-covered fill vocab + guide-phrases) = 1803 rows LIVE + lane=serving, so public surfaces always render; editable in admin. Bespoke editorial = 932 rows DRAFT, admin-only, awaiting Marie.

coverage_ledger.grounded: All content is Marie's authored/verbatim material from tldr-astro-records.json and the mustache templates; moon-phase bank is grounded in her lunation frame. Nothing invented.

partial_sources.vocab/planet-in-sign: personal-planet x sign not exhaustive (Marie has not published every combo); missing combos resolve via fallback vocab/planet-vocab.

partial_sources.vocab/dignity: 6 of 12 signs; missing resolve via vocab/aspect-vocab / dignity-tag.

coverage_ledger.rule: Every partial source chains to a fully-covered fallback, then to phrase/guide-phrase, then SOURCE_GAP. No live card renders a raw slot. These are content gaps (Marie has not written them), not wiring gaps: the slot map is 0-gap.

runtime_key_bridge.note: Old fallback-hook/{route} request keys -> new library targets. DO NOT rename content keys; the runtime aliases the old request to the new template/record, then resolves the template's slots via slot_resolution_map. Covers the 41 canonical fallback-hook routes; Codex confirms against the runtime's actual request keys and extends if any differ.

slot_resolution_map.note: Maps every template slot to its source. fact=calculated astrology; flag=computed boolean; interpretive=authored record (type+category) with scope_from wiring; gap=needs authoring. scope_from '$x' means the value of fact-slot x; literals pass through. select is the pick rule inside the resolved record (e.g. one_of a variant list, or a named field/sentence).

rows.body: Mercury turns back through {sign} in your {house} house, so plans, messages, and details in {house area} are more likely to snag. Back things up, re-confirm times, and revise what keeps resurfacing rather than forcing anything new. If it glitches anyway, adjust and move on.

{Planet} meets the Sun in {sign} — a brief clarity peak in your {house} house. Whatever this cycle has been teaching about {house area} shows up more clearly now. Set one clean intention; watch for the answer in ordinary places.

{Planet} enters {sign} and moves into your {house} house, turning attention to {house area}. Expect {sign-flavored behavior}. Put the energy toward {one concrete house action}, and don't {sign-flavored excess}.

Jupiter enters {sign} in your {house} house for about a year, expanding {house area}. This is permission to {sign growth}, but the same door can lead to {sign overgrowth}. Grow the part that's sustainable.
{Outer planet} begins a long passage through {sign} in your {house} house. The shift in {house area} won't be obvious day to day — it works over years. Notice the direction, not the single event.
Today's Moon works your {house} house, so {house area} is where the friction or pull shows up. Take one small action, don't chase instant results, and don't let the inner critic run the show.
{Planet}'s long transit sits in your {house} house, so {house area} changes gradually. Don't force the single moment; track the trend.

Uranus → sudden shake-ups and upgrades in {house area}; expect the unexpected, stay flexible. Neptune → {house area} gets dreamy and blurry; inspiring but easy to idealize — get real where it counts. Pluto → deep, irreversible transformation of power in {house area}; what's hollow gets composted. Chiron → an old sore spot in {house area} asks for patient tending, then becomes something you can teach. Nodes → your {houseA}/{houseB} axis is activated: grow toward {NN house}, release the over-reliance on {SN house}.

This week tears down early, asks you to sit with it midweek, and hands the energy back by the weekend. Notice what falls apart by Wednesday, process it Thursday and Friday, and choose where to spend the energy Saturday and Sunday.

NEW MOON

The lunar cycle is beginning again. {{new_beginning_scene}} does not need a finished plan yet. Choose {{seed_action}}, and give it enough privacy to take root.

The work is in refinement now. Look closely at {{developing_effort}} and adjust what is almost, but not quite, supporting it. {{refinement_action}}.

rows.headline: Moon phase: Full Moon

FULL MOON

Something has reached visibility. {{culmination_scene}} may show you what has grown and what can no longer be overlooked. Acknowledge {{clear_result}}, then decide what deserves a response.

rows.headline: Moon phase: Waning Gibbous
rows.body:
WANING GIBBOUS MOON

The cycle is turning toward integration. Put words around {{lesson_or_result}} while it is still fresh. Share what is useful, and release the need to make the experience mean everything.

rows.headline: Moon phase: Last Quarter
rows.body:
LAST QUARTER MOON

Revision is part of the work now. {{outgrown_structure}} may have carried you this far without being able to carry you further. {{release_or_revision_action}}.

rows.headline: Moon phase: Balsamic Moon
rows.body:
BALSAMIC MOON

The lunar cycle is closing. Let {{ending_scene}} become quieter instead of forcing one more result from it. Compost {{outgrown_pattern}}, and leave room for the next beginning.

rows.body: You build your future by initiating, leading, and being first. Your public path wants directness and courage, and you get there by starting what others hesitate to start.
You build your future steadily, through patience, craft, and things of real value. Your public path grows slowly and lasts, and you get there by making something solid.
You build your future through communication, curiosity, and connecting ideas and people. Your public path wants variety and conversation, and you get there by asking better questions.
You build your future through care, nurturing, and emotional attunement. Your public path is about protecting and holding, and you get there by tending what you and others need.
You build your future by being seen, creating, and leading from the heart. Your public path wants warmth and expression, and you get there by doing what genuinely delights you.
You build your future through skill, service, and useful, discerning work. Your public path is practical and improving, and you get there by being genuinely good at the craft.
You build your future through relationship, fairness, and collaboration. Your public path develops with partners and clients, and you get there by creating balance.
You build your future through depth, intensity, and transformation. Your public path wants to go beneath the surface, and you get there by facing what others avoid.
You build your future through meaning, teaching, and the bigger view. Your public path wants freedom and truth, and you get there by exploring and sharing what you learn.
You build your future through innovation, community, and challenging the status quo. Your public path is future-facing and networked, and you get there by thinking differently.
Natural: The planet is in its own sign, at home and working at full strength.
Empowered: The planet is exalted here, honored and operating close to its best.
Constrained: The planet sits opposite its rulership, working against the grain and needing more support.
Weakened: The planet sits opposite its exaltation, diminished and asking for patience.
Neutral: The planet has no essential dignity here, so it takes its cue from the rest of the chart.
A first-house year centers you: identity, body, presence, and fresh starts. The Lord of the Year is your chart ruler, and the whole year is about who you are becoming.
A second-house year centers money, possessions, values, and self-worth. Focus on what you earn, own, and value, and on building a stable base.
A third-house year centers communication, learning, siblings, and daily local life. Focus on messages, skills, and the rhythm of your everyday.
A fourth-house year centers home, family, roots, and your private foundation. Focus on where you live and your emotional security; it can bring moves, endings, or a reckoning with lineage.
A fifth-house year centers creativity, romance, pleasure, and children. Focus on what you make, who you date, and where you find joy.
A sixth-house year centers work, health, routine, and service. Focus on the daily grind, the body, and the systems that run your life.
A seventh-house year centers partnership, one-to-one relationships, and open conflict. Focus on the people you commit to and the agreements you make.
An eighth-house year centers shared resources, intimacy, debt, and transformation. Focus on what you share, what you inherit, and what needs to change slowly.
A ninth-house year centers belief, study, travel, and the bigger picture. Focus on meaning, learning, and expanding beyond the familiar.
A tenth-house year centers career, reputation, and public role. Focus on your work in the world and how you are seen.
An eleventh-house year centers friends, community, and future hopes. Focus on your networks, your people, and the goals you are building toward.
A twelfth-house year centers rest, retreat, the hidden, and release. Focus on what is ending, what is unconscious, and the need for solitude and healing.

The fourth house is father and fathering (biological father via the 4th and its ruler; fathering as a concept elsewhere). It is also loss, not only death but the losses and grievings that don't circle death. The 4th and 10th are the meridian, the spine of the chart, your upbringing. It signifies foundations, land, legacy, burial, and hidden or recovered wealth; a basement, a crypt, a bunker, wealth as protection. Co-significators: the Moon (the body, the buried body, remaking the body, birth, memory that changes as it is rediscovered) and Saturn (the revolving nature of loss, attachment, cycles). It multiplies in meaning by life phase: biological father first, real estate around the first Saturn return, and the grave and its rites in the last phase. Timing: fourth-house profection years bring loss (Saturn opposing itself, the progressed Moon return with the nodes reversing, leaving the thirties for the forties, entering the fifties); 27 is often a first big loss. Method: orient the chart from the meridian, then return it to the self by asking how the parent, loss, or legacy shapes identity.
The fourth house is where the bodies are buried.
There is always change in the fourth house, but there is nothing new.
The fourth house is a place we can't not return to.
Memories aren't stored and static; they change because they are always being rediscovered.
Grief is so physical that it takes on its own shape.

The seventh house is social identity, how you communicate who you are to your wider community, more than marriage (which rarely dominates a 7th-house year in practice). It is self-becoming and active decision-making: choosing who you could become and making choices with domino effects on your future self. Co-significators: the Sun and Moon, the luminaries, childish planets of self-becoming. It carries self-consciousness and visibility over the horizon, the "that's who I am" epiphany, and the awkwardness of moving in a new trajectory. By phase: marriage, then conflicts and enemies, then business partnerships; 7th-house years (7, 18, then 30, 42, 54) are threshold years of serious change. Working with it: big decisions bring anticipatory homesickness; you're allowed to change your mind, you don't lose who you've always been, and early discomfort doesn't mean a wrong choice.

The eighth house is Death, loss, and lack of control (opposite the second house of control). Planets here are diminished and inhibited, not darker or more powerful; don't catastrophize them, they work slowly and need more support. It is inheritance in the broad sense: objects, emotions, histories, and ancestral wounds that take generations, things you remember without trying and do for your ancestors rather than yourself. Co-significators: Saturn (slow, suited to the house's long historicality) and the Moon (rejoices here in a nocturnal, well-aspected chart; often inheritance of physical objects). By phase: death, then old inherited things, then anguish and legacy. Working with it: eighth-house planets need trust, and failing that, trust the passage of time; the word is "eventually." It supports the seventh house through big, quiet, imperceptible-but-total change.

The ninth house is God, the house of power: institutions (religious or academic), publishing, travel, recognition, and the social class of men. Higher education is a recent meaning; older ones are prophecy, vision, soothsaying, religion, and your relationship to the king. It is the Sun's temple and the house of imagination, political will, and the capacity to create futures not yet available; an experimental house between the eighth and the tenth. Co-significators: Jupiter (the backbone; holds beliefs like stones, self-assured in knowledge) and the Sun (rejoices here, hungry for knowledge, always needs an escape route). Mars is angry in Jupiter's house and causes trouble. By phase: travel, then beliefs and recognizing institutions, then prophecy and vision (the old are better at uncertainty). Working with it: examine your relationship to dreaming the future, believing in yourself, and being seen; the ninth may live in a novel or a forum, not only school.

The tenth house is the mother (as the fourth is the father) and the midheaven, held to be the most influential angle: glory, honors, reputation, all our actions, and career. "Career" traces to chariot and to Roman status under the state, so purpose-through-work carries aristocratic, militarized baggage. Really it is mothering, which is not gender-specific: you mother a child, an idea, a movement, or yourself into being; mothers are a lineage of methods and habits, not meant to exist in isolation. Co-significator: Mars (no planet rejoices here); the tenth carries the state, protection, and a courage that often fights because it is afraid. By phase: the mother (years at 9 and 21), then honors and fame, then stabilizing its meanings. Working with it: read the sign as a lineage of mothering, ask what you want to protect and how; don't reduce it to a job, since purpose isn't labor and can change.

The eleventh house is friendship, which changes across life: hope first, friends second, grace and benefits third, each feeding the next. Adult friendship requires learning freedom, a cultivated skill; you make friends by revealing your oddities, by being weird, not by networking. Co-significators: the Sun and Jupiter; it mirrors the ninth and means fellowship, equality, and fraternity, and classically the love received from women. Jupiter here is generosity, giving before you know it returns, friends who give exactly what you need. Working with it: hard transits reveal who has truly been a friend; you can teach them or let them learn without you; there's no real line between friends and lovers, so date your friends.

The twelfth house is "bad spirit," where Saturn rejoices and gains accidental dignity. Classically it ruled enslaved people and foreign places, then asylums, prisons, and attics; the house of enmity is also the house of resistance, the house of self-sacrifice also the house of escape. It holds attic ghosts and the unmemorialized dead, and what your birthing parent repressed in pregnancy. Its truths only surface at a slow pace, since big animals live longer but slower. Co-significators: Venus (denied or forbidden pleasure, anticipating exclusion, reteaching yourself that you're not a secret) and Saturn (rejoices, urgency, fear of not having enough time, wishing away the body). Planets here read as childhood denials: Venus denied pleasure, Mars denied emotional expression, Jupiter denied freedom, Saturn denied time. Working with it: follow the ghosts, acknowledge something else is in the room, use imagination to make your way, and loosen your idea of "enough."
The ninth house is the house of freedom.
In a world where futures are sold, not all of us are able to access a future.
The old are better at uncertainty.
The eighth house is not a scary influence but a diminished influence.
With the eighth house, remember the word "eventually."
Eighth-house planets are not out to get you; they need more support.
You never really lose the person you have always been.
If you're uncomfortable at first, it doesn't mean you made the wrong decision.
Your past decisions are the things that exposed you to new information in the first place.
You mother a poem into being.
Some of our most courageous people are also the most scared.
You are enough even when you feel minuscule.
Imagination is the only way you can contend with uncertainty.
ruled by Jupiter, exalts Venus, falls (depresses) Mercury; also Mercury's detriment. Defined by its relationship to the benefics; the only sign that dignifies both Venus and Jupiter in a major way.
dignifies Mercury (domicile), debilitates Jupiter (detriment), depresses Venus (fall). Mercurial: sharp mind, strong memory, helps through reduction and efficiency.
ruled by Venus, exalts Saturn. The king of boundaries: selective, cool, well-organized socially; needs time to know its own feelings.
dignifies both malefics (Saturn domicile, Mars exalted). Works through elimination; minimal, no waste; "that's not for me."
dignifies Jupiter (domicile), Mercury's detriment. Fire: talks and thinks a lot; hears what it wants; good faith.
Mars domicile; forgiving but investigative, seeks catharsis through full understanding.

The improviser. Says "Yes, and," trusts the people and the process rather than the plan, and draws talent and ambition out of collaborators by sincerely believing in them. Flexible but committed to a vision; bored by smallness and solo goals; wants things that only happen when a community moves together. Appears to do little, but invitation, availability, and trust are actions.

Works through elimination (dignifies both malefics). Knows what it is here to do by knowing what it is not here to do; says "that's not for me" quietly and firmly. Minimal, wastes nothing, waits for the right time. Distinguishes authority (power over your own life) from status (a role for others); tough on the surface with deep nostalgia underneath.

Guarded, regal, self-taught toughness; absorbs parental pressure and describes the mother. Starts systems and holds responsibility, but over-self-critiques. Saturn's promise is slow and cannot be rushed with self-improvement; the power of group work is endurance, not speed. Underneath the big plans, the real aim is to gather people, to make friends who last.

Gives off an unbothered, wander-off vibe but actually facilitates the group and becomes a pillar of community. Selective, a minimal sharer who needs respect and time; doesn't take sides in conflict and supports the underdog at personal cost. Popular without seeming popular; the ideal day is spent alone.

Saturn's joy: it gains accidental dignity and grows stronger here. The house of nameless fears, phobias, and unlamented sorrows. Helps you name what you have been avoiding, including addictions. Intensely self-aware and able to read themselves, but the trap is too much foresight: treating well-studied doubts as prophecies. Your doubts are not prophecies; you might have more choices than you think.
When you meet your opposite, you notice everything about them that other people might not always see.
Flexibility is not the same as indecision.
Invitation, availability, and trust are also actions. Connection is an action.
Authority is the power to make choices about your own life. Status is the role that you play for other people.
The power of group work isn't speed. It's endurance.
Saturn doesn't want you to become faster, more efficient, or more competitive. It just wants you to act your age.
Your doubts, even your very well studied doubts, aren't prophecies.
Just because fear helps us create narratives doesn't mean that those narratives are prophecies.
You don't know what can happen until you try.
Starting at the wrong time wastes more time than waiting for the right time.
For two opposite signs to complement one another, they both have to be willing to receive in addition to giving.
When a Libra really knows themselves, no one can sway them.
Action isn't quantified by disruption.

rows.body: You feel a pull to lead, act, and put yourself first, even though it's unfamiliar. Follow the hunger toward your own wants and let yourself take up space.
You're being drawn toward steadiness, your own resources, and simple physical pleasure. Grow by building real security and self-worth, and by letting yourself receive.
Curiosity is the growth edge. You're pulled to ask questions, learn widely, and hold more than one truth at once, so follow what interests you instead of clinging to a single fixed answer.
You're being drawn toward feeling, nurturing, and letting yourself be cared for. Grow by tending your inner life and your home, and by letting people in.
The pull is toward your own creative heart and being seen. Grow by expressing yourself, taking the spotlight, and doing what genuinely delights you.
You're drawn toward useful, grounded work and the details of daily life. Grow by refining your craft, tending your health, and being of real service.
The growth edge is relationship and fairness. You're pulled to consider others, share, and build partnership, so practice meeting people halfway.
You're being drawn into depth, intimacy, and the things you'd rather not look at. Grow by trusting someone with the real thing and letting yourself be changed.
The pull is toward meaning, faith, and a bigger view. Grow by trusting your own sense of truth and exploring beyond the familiar.
You're drawn toward responsibility, structure, and building something that lasts. Grow by committing to a goal and doing the patient, unglamorous work.
The growth edge is community and the bigger picture. You're pulled toward your people, your ideals, and the future, so contribute to something larger than yourself.
You're being drawn toward imagination, surrender, and compassion. Grow by softening, dreaming, and trusting what you can't fully control.
You can release the habit of over-pleasing and over-compromising. You already know how to keep the peace, so it's safe to stop abandoning yourself to be liked.
You can let go of old secrets, power struggles, and entanglements you've outgrown. Growth here is pruning, so release the inner ghosts you keep circling.
You can release dogma and the need to always chase the next horizon. It's safe to let go of beliefs that no longer fit and to declutter what you've overrun.
You can loosen your grip on perfectionism, over-analysis, and the critical inner voice. You already know how to fix and refine, so let some things be good enough.
You can release the reflex to go it alone and fight everything solo. It's safe to soften the me-first push and let others in.
You can let go of clinging to comfort, possessions, and the familiar. Your security doesn't have to come from holding on so tightly.
You can release restless information-gathering and the need to have every answer. It's safe to trust what you already deeply know instead of collecting more.
You can loosen the pull toward retreating and over-caretaking. It's okay to come out of the shell and be seen in the world.
You can release the need for constant approval and center stage. Your worth doesn't depend on the applause.
You can let go of over-controlling, over-working, and defining yourself by achievement. It's safe to loosen the grip on status and duty.
You can release detachment and hiding inside the group. It's safe to be personally seen rather than only part of the collective.
You can let go of escapism and dissolving into everyone else. It's safe to come back to solid ground.
An aspect is not a fixed verdict but a live process linking two drives, and worked with consciously it can give each of them more freedom rather than less.

DO: expect delays; build buffer time into the schedule back up files, documents, photos before the station reflect, review, revise, reorganize; note what keeps recurring (there's meaning in it) streamline systems; triple-check dates/times; comb the calendar; re-confirm details favor long-term, deliberate choices over off-the-cuff ones call yourself out when passive-aggressive; script and rehearse the hard conversation edit messages carefully before sending; gather thoughts, reread drafts laugh at obvious mistakes; stay humble and open to learning DON'T: fear it or treat worry as prevention; reframe as a chance to reassess strategy buy tickets / sign contracts / launch big things if avoidable (or stay flexible, expect adjustments) make major life changes unless timed around the cazimi put life fully on hold — brace for hiccups, proceed wisely EVENT NOTE: cazimi mid-retrograde = clarifying peak; "lessons show up more clearly"; watch dreams, overheard snippets, social posts. Retrograde-in-water-sign flavor (Cancer): withdrawing/scuttling sideways from conflict, passive-aggression, taking misunderstanding personally → name the feeling instead; lessons on expressing the vulnerable side.

what it is: Sun–planet conjunction in the same sign; the planet is "in the heart of the Sun," washed/renewed by its light; can occur retrograde or direct. use: treat as a clarity peak within a longer cycle; set/renew intentions tied to that planet's domain; watch for insight arriving through ordinary channels.

structure CC uses: date-in/date-out → what the planet does (decisive action) → what the sign changes it into (buzzing desire to share/learn/talk) → why this ingress is notable (unusually long stay) → per-sign house effects. Mars-in-Gemini lived flavor: scattered drive across many interests; words as weapons/tools; restlessness; do-many-things energy.

frame: "Jupiter passes a megaphone to a new sign" (~1 yr each; ~12-yr return). Expansion + permission theme. Jupiter-in-Leo lived flavor: collective hunger for self-expression, play, visibility, drama, "full permission" to be seen. Excess: over-performance, ego inflation.

Chiron in Taurus (source guide): multi-round ingress ( R1, R2, R3); "new cycle of working with" the sore spot in the sign's domain (Taurus: body, worth, resources, security); healing/mentorship register; slow. Pluto / generations (source essay): 10–20 yrs per sign; "demands a long view"; generational cohorts; transformation of collective power structures; personal effect subtle until seen in retrospect. rows.body: Your direction meets an obstacle — a limit, a duty, or an authority saying not yet. It can feel like being blocked or doubted. Treat it as a test of commitment: do the unglamorous part, and the confidence you build is real rather than borrowed.

Your goals run up against hard reality or someone else's constraints, and the gap between where you are and where you want to be feels stark. Don't read the limit as a verdict on your worth. Name what's in your control and put steady work there.

Warmth meets caution: a relationship, or your sense of being valued, feels tested, distant, or effortful, and doubt about being wanted can creep in. Ask for what you need directly instead of withdrawing, and let the connection prove itself through what people do.

Drive meets intensity, and force wants to become domination — of a situation or a person. Power struggles and all-or-nothing pushes are the trap. Aim the intensity at real change rather than winning, and don't torch a bridge you'll need.

Thinking gets foggy, idealized, or hard to pin down; facts blur and it's easy to hear what you want to hear. Don't sign or promise on a hunch. Check the details against something solid before you commit.

Thoughts turn heavy, careful, and self-critical, and communication can feel slow or blocked. The upside is precision and follow-through. Say the plain, structured version, and don't mistake the seriousness for pessimism.

Attraction turns sudden and electric — a crush, a spark, an urge to shake up how you love or spend. Exciting, but restless and not always durable. Enjoy the novelty without mistaking a jolt for a foundation.

Identity meets deep pressure: something asks you to drop a hollow version of yourself and get honest about power. It can feel like a confrontation or a reckoning. Let what's false fall away instead of gripping for control.

Drive and confidence swell together — bold moves feel easy and the appetite for more is high. Great for starting things, risky for overreach. Take the big swing, but size it to what you can actually follow through on.

Growth pushes against limits: you want to expand while something says slow down and consolidate. The friction is between optimism and realism. Grow, but build the structure that makes the growth hold.
Ambition and structure work with each other: steady effort pays off and discipline feels supportive rather than heavy. A good window to commit to something long-term and build it properly.
Affection and commitment sit easily together; a relationship or your sense of worth feels stable and worth the effort. Good for defining what you want and making it durable.
Thinking is clear, careful, and organized — you can plan, focus, and say the precise thing. Use it for the serious conversation or the detailed work.
Energy and discipline cooperate: you can work hard without burning out and finish what you start. Steady, productive drive.
Warmth and generosity flow — good feeling, social ease, and a little luck in love and money. Enjoy it, and be generous without overextending.
Confidence and opportunity align; things feel expansive and doors open. A good time to say yes to growth you can honor.
Focused intensity that can move mountains when it's aimed — deep drive without the power struggle. Channel it into real, lasting change.
Love and imagination blend beautifully; romance, art, and compassion flow. Lovely — just keep one foot on the ground about what's real.
Feelings turn heavy, serious, or lonely and you may want to withdraw. Real, but don't mistake the mood for the truth. Tend to yourself and let it pass.
Emotions meet a cold wall and you feel unsupported, blocked, or not enough. Comfort yourself first, then deal with the actual limit rather than the feeling of it.
Your needs collide with duty or someone's distance; you feel torn between caring for yourself and holding it together. Make room for the feeling without dropping the responsibility.
Feelings run hot and reactive: irritation, defensiveness, a short fuse. Move the energy through your body before you say the thing you'll regret.
Feelings turn soft, affectionate, and pleasure-seeking; you want comfort and closeness. A good window for warmth, connection, and self-care.
Moods get foggy, porous, or escapist; you soak up everyone's feelings and lose the thread of your own. Rest, and don't make big emotional decisions in the haze.
Feelings run deep and intense and something buried can surface. Powerful for honesty, risky for brooding. Let it move through instead of gripping it.
Emotional intensity meets a power dynamic: jealousy, control, or an old feeling demanding attention. Feel it fully, then choose your response rather than react.
Feelings and identity move as one. What you need and who you are point the same direction, so you feel most yourself when you honor the mood.
A small opening to line up how you feel with what you are doing. Take the easy step and let the mood carry the day.
Your needs pull against your goals. What would comfort you and what you think you should be doing are at odds, so choose one on purpose.
Who you are and how you feel agree without effort. Confidence and comfort come easily today.
Your outer self and your inner feelings sit across from each other. Let both be true instead of picking a side.
Feeling and thought run together. You feel what you think and want to talk it out, so say the tender thing plainly.
An easy chance to put a feeling into words. The conversation you have been avoiding gets simpler now.
Head and heart bicker. You overthink a mood or talk yourself out of a real feeling, so quiet the mental noise first.
It is easy to name what you feel. Gentle, honest talking flows.
Logic and mood pull opposite ways. You feel one thing and think another, so hear both out before you decide.
A soft opening for warmth, affection, and small pleasures. Reach for the comforting, lovely thing.
You want comfort and you want closeness, and they are slightly crossed. Watch soothing yourself with spending or sweets.
Tenderness comes easily. A warm, affectionate mood that is good for closeness and for treating yourself kindly.
What you need pulls against what you value in someone else. Balance your own comfort with theirs.
Feelings run hot and fast. A mood moves you to act, which is powerful when aimed and reactive when not.
A chance to turn a feeling into action. Do the small brave thing the mood is pointing at.
Emotion fuels action smoothly. You are moved by what you actually care about, so put the energy to work.
Your need for comfort meets someone's heat or push. Irritation flares, so move your body before you snap.
The heart runs generous and the mood expands. Warm, hopeful, and big-hearted, just watch the urge to overdo it.

Your emotions and your optimism are lining up easily, so a warm, hopeful feeling wants to rise in you. Let yourself lean into it and feel it move through your body, rather than brushing it off or holding back. Just let it be what it is, without forcing it bigger or overdoing it.
Feeling and optimism overinflate. You promise the world on a good mood, so enjoy it and keep the commitments realistic.
Warm, hopeful, and genuinely generous. A feel-good flow that is easy to share.
Your need for comfort pulls against the hunger for more. You feel restless for something bigger than what already soothes you.
A chance to give a feeling some structure. A steadying routine or a small boundary helps the mood settle.
Steady, contained feelings. There is real comfort in routine, discipline, and knowing where you stand.
Moods turn sudden and restless and you need room to breathe. Expect the unexpected in how you feel.
A chance to try a fresh emotional approach. Break a small routine and notice how it feels.
Emotional restlessness. You want to bolt from the familiar and feelings arrive without warning, so give yourself space.
Refreshing emotional freedom. Change feels easy and you are comfortable doing it your own way.
Your need for security pulls against the urge to break away. Something or someone disrupts your comfort zone.
Feelings turn dreamy and porous. You soak up the room and drift, lovely for imagination and risky for boundaries.
A gentle opening for intuition and compassion. Follow the soft nudge to create something or care for someone.
Soft, imaginative, and easily empathic. A tender, creative, forgiving mood.
Your feelings blur with everyone else's. It is hard to tell your mood from the room's, so get quiet and check.
A chance to go one level deeper without drama. Let an honest feeling surface and actually look at it.
Emotional intensity and a pull toward control. Brooding or a quiet power struggle over feelings, so let it move through you.
Deep feeling that renews you. You can be honest about the heavy thing and come out lighter.
An old feeling surfaces and a sore spot goes tender. Be gentle with yourself, this is a place that still heals.
A gentle chance to tend an old sore spot. One small, kind act toward the tender part goes a long way.
An old hurt gets poked and you go defensive. Notice the reaction before you act on it.
Comfort in the healing. It is easier than usual to feel the tender thing without being swamped by it.
Someone brushes the old sore spot. What they do lands on a bruise, so tend the bruise, not just the person.

Your drive locks onto something you're genuinely hungry for, and there's real momentum behind it. Point it at a goal that actually matters and go, but watch the tendency to get so caught up in wanting that you skip your basic needs.

Venus retrograde in Aries and Pisces TL;DR: Venus retrograde is a course correction of the heart. A necessary pause. An invitation to examine what we’ve been taught to want, who we’ve been conditioned to love, and what we’ve been told we deserve. This is not just about romance, it’s about self-worth. It’s about the contracts we’ve made, knowingly or not, with love, beauty, money, and desire. Venus retrograde does not return what was lost. It reveals why it was never truly yours. Why you let it go. Why it slipped through your fingers. And why, no matter how tightly you hold on, some things are meant to end. Jump to Horoscopes Venus retrograde is a course correction of the heart, a reversal of the currents that pull us toward pleasure, love, and material entanglement. It is the planetary embodiment of the quote: "Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want." - Eric Jorgenson and Naval Ravikant. When Venus retrogrades, the terms of that contract are revisited, renegotiated, or outright burned. What we crave, what we attract, and what we believe we deserve all come under scrutiny. From March 1 to April 12, 2025, Venus moves backward through Aries and Pisces. When she enters Pisces, fantasy dissolves. Illusions crack. Unresolved emotions rise to the surface. The past is closer than it seems. Aries demanded action, but Pisces dissolves it. The battlefield turns to fog. The passion turns to longing. What you fought for now feels like a dream slipping through your fingers. Where have you romanticized the past or held onto a dream that no longer belongs to you? This is not new. You have been here before. Look back to the last Venus Rx, March 4th to April 15th, 2017. Venus in Aries (March 1, April 3) Aries is not a patient lover.

rows.body: Aries demanded action, Pisces asks for surrender. The chase turns into longing. The certainty of Aries is replaced by questions- was it ever real? Was it ever meant to be? This is where we romanticize the past, where dreams slip through our fingers. If Aries was about fighting for love, Pisces is about grieving it. Venus Rx conjoins Neptune in Pisces, March 27, 2025 (9:13 AM EST) Neptune is illusion. Neptune is longing. Neptune is the love story that exists more in memory than reality. When Venus meets Neptune in retrograde, we see where we have deceived ourselves. This is a beautiful transit for art, for poetry, for nostalgia - but a dangerous one for clarity. Beware of old fantasies returning in disguise. Not everything that glitters is gold. Venus Rx conjoins the North Node in Pisces, April 1, 2025 (4:38 AM EST) A fated encounter. The North Node pulls us toward the future, but Venus retrograde is caught in the past. This is a collision of old patterns and new possibilities. A lesson in worth, love, and what must be left behind in order to move forward. Venus stations direct in Pisces, April 12, 2025 (9:02 PM EST) The cycle completes. Venus stops moving backward and begins her slow return to forward motion. The journey from Aries to Pisces has been one of confrontation and surrender - facing the ways we fight for love, and then learning to let go of what was never truly ours. What was once unclear now sharpens into focus. The past releases its grip. The dream fades. Reality returns. Revisiting Past Relationships Love doesn’t always end with finality. Some connections fade, not from lack of feeling, but from timing, distance, or the weight of what was left unsaid.

rows.body: The Taurus new moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks, and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. This is great if it’s been moving you in a positive direction, but also know that any secrets, addictions, or underhanded behavior will also come to light soon. How much you value yourself is apparent in what you’re manifesting externally. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. This new moon can signal a time to find a mentor or advisor. Someone to help you save time and effort while staying motivated and learning from their experience. While having a mentor or guide can be helpful, it’s key to remember that the power lies within you to take action on the guidance you receive. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow. Keep showing up for yourself and believing in your talents, and your beauty, compassion, and creativity will be seen. Your intention for the Taurus new moon is, “even when my patience is tested, I find strength in envisioning my future goals.”

The Taurus new moon is illuminating your 1st house of Self. This new moon is a reminder to honor yourself and all you are. This new moon in your home sign creates some dynamic tension between home, work, and your identity, or how you view yourself within these areas of your life. Maybe a new version of yourself is being birthed, and a reorganization in your external world is underway. Focus on who you are and how you want to express yourself. The chaos of change will eventually subside, and consistency will set in again. This is a time to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The Taurus new moon wants you to be your own source of recognition and control; instead of letting others dictate your worth and value. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your own wellspring of internal support. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize on how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. You’re moving to a new experience and will need the self-confidence to get there. Channel the energy of Taurus and Venus to step into your self-worth and walk confidently.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, there may be a habitual pattern that’s creating resistance within you, avoiding slowing down and getting the rest you need. Use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. Reflect on your purpose and hold it in your heart, regardless of how much suffering seems to surround you. Everything will pass and everything is temporary. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, which symbolizes endings. You may be in the process of rebuilding one of the structures in your life: such as finding yourself after the ending of a significant relationship/marriage, morning the loss of a loved one, transitioning and rebuilding your life after a significant change in your career (bankruptcy, selling a business, retirement, layoff or other change in your career). You could also be feeling a sense of relief after expending energy into an area of your life; and once the shock abates now that you release what couldn’t be fixed. Learning to let go can be hard; especially since the brain can experience cognitive tension if a task is left unfinished. Sometimes we exhaust ourselves trying to fix, heal or complete something that's beyond our control or simply doesn't need to be fixed. The new moon in Taurus guides you in understanding that you did the best you could do; with what you had. And, when it comes down to what was out of your control, it’s ok to let go and move on. It’s a process, but allowing yourself to not be consumed by the what-ifs, frees up energy for the next cycle to begin. The new moon in the 12 house teaches you that life is all about flow, and when you center yourself within this infinite energy you can trust that it will guide you. No time is wasted, even if you feel like you may have lost months/years on something that recently ended or ended. Remember, when you are in flow with the Universe, you are constantly guided towards a life built on truth, your greater and true happiness.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. Good friends are good for your health, and this new moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. Surround yourself with friends and people who share your same values and vision for the future. Stay close to those you trust. Community and networking are a big focus for you now. Friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. If you are looking to be discovered and seen for your art and talents - now is the time to take action and set those intentions. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc., this is a time to set the intention to have yourself, and your work is seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 10th house of career and purpose. Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself daily and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your career. Sudden changes in status, responsibility or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future. Usually, Devils symbolize struggle with a moral problem - lust or love, so it's important to identify and steer clear of any romantic obsessions or fantasies at work which could sabotage your financial freedom. You may realize a shift in your values and beliefs or realize that you have taken on the views of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. This is a time to set the intention to align your career with your core values and interests. If you've ever struggled with ambition, life direction, status, public identity, life mission, authority, or responsibility, then this Aries new moon is a time to renew and rebirth who you are. It's time for a personal quest that will lead you to discover what matters most to you and how you can use your strengths to help others. It's time to stop waiting for someone else to permit you and start taking ownership of your life. Take time each day to unpack how you want to show up. What story do you want? What experience do you want? Redefine your core values and ensure everything that comes after aligns with those values. Aspire to grow in genuine and meaningful ways, so your ambition isn't just a means to an end but part of a larger purpose.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. Use this New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Other cultures, and traveling helps give you perspective in situations in your life that may feel clogged and stifled. Keep your mind open to new perspectives and new worlds begin to open up. Seeing things in the bigger picture isn’t always your strong point, but now you can begin to see the forest for the trees as new information and understandings help you gain perspective. Learn new cultures, explore new ideas, and adopt new ways of thinking to expand your mind. Which new opportunities and paths did you open up to, and what did these new experiences teach you? If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of life's mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, ground yourself in earthly matters. If you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Your intention for this New Moon is, “How can I reconnect to my sense of purpose and spirituality so I can plan my path?”

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, Symbolism, Shared Resources, and Other People's Money. It’s a time of transformation and trusting in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself most of all. What you thought gave you security, may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. Your natural flexibility will help you ride the waves. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize, and being in connection with another may remind you of this whether it’s birthed out of a deep connection, or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven’t been addressed are now arising asking for changes in your relationships. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, however uncomfortable or painful the solutions may seem. This energy can manifest as a sudden desire for a necessary change in lifestyle; perhaps you realize your current lifestyle is not sustainable; or blocks you from reaching your personal life goals. The new moon in your 8th house can signal a time to delve deep into the mysteries of life and explore all the hidden corners of your soul. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Relationships bring reflection. Fall in love with yourself and the rest will follow. Ask yourself: what am I afraid of when it comes to commitment or abandonment? Face your feelings with courage and honesty and allow yourself to be vulnerable. Don't be afraid to ask for support from the people around you. The Taurus new moon is giving you the opportunity to make necessary changes to help you evolve as a person and as a partner. Sometimes it's easier to be more compassionate to those in your intimate relationship than yourself. Give yourself the same emotional support you would give another. Don't try to change or suppress your emotions - just allow them to be and allow yourself to feel them. Free up space to let your feelings pass through you without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, ask yourself where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions. Then, take some time to look inside and get to the root of these issues. You can do this with the support of your friends and family and with a bit of self-compassion.

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. You may find that your health, work, and daily routines are changing as new information challenges and evolves stuck patterns. The best thing you can do is be flexible. Anything arising right now it to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you’ve been giving to much, now’s the time to focus on yourself. Virgo and the Hermit observe. With patience, contemplation, and observation you can make small changes in your daily routines which can add up to create more stability and structure in your life. Your new moon intentions, “I am fully appreciated for the service and compassion I offer to others.”

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, passion, and creativity. Love, pleasure, relationships, children's creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront for you. Take this opportunity to promise yourself that you will allow and encourage more passions to flow into your life with this New Moon. Does your desire to receive love and validation lead you to abandon a part of yourself that you would otherwise cherish? Returning to an old hobby or enjoyable pastime may lift your spirits. By doing so, you will be able to reintegrate parts of yourself that you may have abandoned. It’s important for you to stay connected to what you love. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you, not just by you. Your new moon intention, “my humor, charisma, and optimism magnetize love and new opportunities to connect.”

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 4th house of home and family. Think about what makes you feel secure and safe, without getting stuck in stagnancy. The new moon the 4th house may have you rethink how you want to set roots or take steps to nurture your roots deeper. Take this time to consider how family fits into your future, and what steps you can take toward cultivating a deeper family connection. It’s possible you’re in the process of moving or rethinking your home environment. This change brings you to a location that better supports your work-life balance; making it easier for you to invest time in your career, without pulling energy away from cultivating a loving and peaceful home life. You could be seeing some changes to your home and family situation right now, or assessing what provides a sense of comfort and security, emotionally as well as physically. Family might need more from you than usual, and this may trigger old wounds, but also help you heal and break free of old limitations. Your Taurus new moon intentions are, “everything I build has the power, integrity, and foundation that can last generations to come.”

The Taurus new moon illuminates your 3rd house of early education, communication, community, siblings, and neighbors. With the new moon in your 3rd house, you may find that your social life is more active, and demanding. You may feel inspired to create more structure in your community; by identifying a need; that, if corrected could bring more flow and harmony within your local community. This new moon may provide you with information and the truth about something you’ve been seeking. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek and give support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new project, open a local business, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who offers you a sense of belonging. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? You may find yourself offering to help build strength within your local community. This could be organizing raising funds, legal counsel, organizing a board to oversee or physically provide labor and resources to organize construction for a needed community building (library, hospital, fire station, school, shelter, local shop, etc.). With the new moon in the 3rd house, choose to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your Taurus new moon intention is, “my word is my gift, and sharing it brings me fulfillment.” # ===== Gemini New Moon (12/12 risings) =====

This Gemini new moon is a reminder of the power of words. Your mind is on fire, and ideas are being downloaded quickly. Share these ideas with others because networking now is where you’ll find the most success. The Gemini new moon encourages you to explore the ideas that excite you. What creative and writing projects can you commit to? You may be ready to start teaching or even return to school. How can you share what you’ve trained in and practiced over the years? The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? With the new moon in the 3rd house, choose to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your new moon intention, “My knowledge is one of my gifts, and sharing it brings me and others fulfillment.”

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. You’re exploring how to create a solid foundation under your feet. Discover what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Figure out what you value most, and find a way to allow yourself to receive emotional connection, love, physical support, and abundance. This New Moon is about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and self-worth. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. Having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow.

This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. This is a time to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your wellspring of internal support. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your new moon intention is, “I seek to know myself in all aspects of myself.”

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Cancer, Luna is your ruler. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, a trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Focus on how this makes you feel. You need to move and feel your way through this information. The new moon in the 12th house also represents rest and reflection - this is a good idea to take some time for yourself and regenerate. This cosmic wheel symbolizes the ever-changing cycles of life and the endings that come with them. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendships and networks. You’re a natural leader, and this New Moon is bringing that out more in you. Network, connect, and create community. Your ideas should be shared and collaborated with others. Community and networking is a big focus for you now. Friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. It's time to be present, connect with others, and become a conduit for connection and kindness. Give someone an encouraging word and help them feel connected and less alone. With the new moon, you are guided to bring hope and compassion back into your shared experience. Attend parties with an open heart, and open mind, and let your Light shine. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. If you are looking to be discovered and seen for your art and talents - now is the time to take action and set those intentions. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc., this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your career. Sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future. How can you support yourself with podcasts, books, or finding a mentor to empower you to expand and step more into a public role? This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path or maybe even a promotion. You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through this time of uncertainty. Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with, will finally arise for resolution or at least discussion. Anchor into yourself while sharing all the gifts that partnerships and co-creating have to bring. The tension will make you stronger, regardless of the outcome.”

You’re needing to create a new self care regimen that will give you more energy and create more stability and routine in your life. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. If you don’t protect your own energy during moments when you are giving more than you are receiving, it will severely deplete you and make you unable to help those around you. During this new moon, take intentional actions to safeguard your energy and prevent yourself from over-giving and ending up drained. The New moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. Your health improves, and opportunities open when you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind. Make health and creativity your primary focus now. Work issues will work themselves out when you focus on yourself for a bit.” # ===== Virgo New Moon (12/12 risings) =====

This includes your work environment and learning to balance work and self-care. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. Slow down and focus on the details of health, work, and daily habits. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 5th house of fun and creativity. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon for you. The Virgo new moon activates your 4th House of Home and Family. Home is where the heart is, and your heart is speaking loudly to you now. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 3rd house of communication and siblings. Communication can sometimes be challenging for your shy and reclusive nature. You worry about speaking properly or not being understood. If confusion arises, make every effort to show up and find ways to bridge the communication gap and create understanding. With the new moon in the 3rd house, choose to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and Foundation. The magick is in healthy day-to-day rituals and steps on your path toward financial health. By having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on, you can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way.

Happy Birthday Virgo! The Virgo new moon is illuminating your 1st house of self. It’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Spend time in nature or practice yoga, write in a journal or meditate. Whatever works for you, make sure to schedule it into your day so that it becomes a regular habit. Some decision you made about 6 months ago is now up for review and revision. Think about all that has transpired since then. Try not to allow any disappointments or grief to keep you from moving forward. You’re focused on yourself, your health, and what you need to do to make your desires a reality, and in doing so you may be in opposition to some important relationships in your life. The Hermits' lessons bring you to wholeness and authenticity. The New Moon in Virgo is a time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize on how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection.

The Virgo new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Making decisions doesn’t always come easy for you, Libra, and this aspect of your personality might be amplified now. It might be best not to make important decisions at the moment. Rest, retreat, and focus on connecting with yourself and your creativity so that you can get clear on your purpose. The external world might feel like an overwhelming mess, but this will pass; you’ll be back to your charming self in no time. Dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. You desire deep connection in every aspect of your life. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. We build trust with others by committing to outcomes that support the greater good.”

The Virgo new moon illuminates your 10th house of career and purpose. You can be perpetually young, but new responsibilities have been put in front of you. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. Traveling and travelers are active in your reality right now and creating a perspective shift on how you approach your life. The Virgo new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. Trust yourself first, and everything else will align.”

The Virgo new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. The Virgo new moon is giving you the opportunity to make necessary changes to help you evolve as a person and as a partner. To tend to your heart in relationship matters, and trust in the cycles of endings and beginnings.” # ===== Libra New Moon (12/12 risings) =====

The Libra new moon activates your 7th house of relationships. As the New Moon in Libra approaches, you may find that your relationships are reflecting back to you some important lessons about commitment and decision-making. This is a time to consider how your unwillingness to commit or make concrete decisions in the past may have led you down unhealthy roads and into unhealthy relationships. It's important to be honest with yourself and others about what you need from relationships. You may lend a listening ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Remember that feeling bad is complicated enough on its own and that trying to repress or suppress your emotions only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions and giving yourself the same emotional support that you would give to someone else. Allow yourself to feel your emotions without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, consider reaching out to friends and family for support and practicing self-compassion. Take the time to explore your emotions and to get to the root of any issues. Remember that it's okay to feel a full range of emotions and that it's important to allow yourself to feel and process them in a healthy way. The new moon in the seventh house is a time of new beginnings and a chance to find balance and fairness in your relationships. Honesty can be a liberating act, and this New Moon offers an opportunity to make changes that will help you to evolve as a person and as a partner. Remember that truth is a priority in all relationships, and now is a good time to get everything out in the open. Some information might be a little jolting or painful, but try to see it as a necessary step towards greater intimacy or separation. During this time, you may also find that you're focusing on balancing your personal needs with the needs of others. You might see new relationships open up as others come to a close, and it's important to trust in the natural cycles of endings and beginnings. Your New Moon's intention is to tend to your heart in relationship matters and to trust in the cycles of life. Remember that a new life is always right around the corner, and take care of yourself as you navigate the ups and downs of relationships.

The Libra new moon activates your 6th house of health, daily work, routine, and being of service. The New Moon in Libra signals a time to focus on creating a new self-care regimen that will help you feel more energized and bring more stability and routine to your life. This might include considering your work environment and finding ways to balance your responsibilities with self-care. It's important to be flexible and to embrace any challenges or changes that arise, as they are likely to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you've been giving too much of yourself lately, now is the time to focus on your own needs. Pushing yourself ahead when it's not the right time for you to move forward will only slow you down in the long run. On the other hand, if you've been obsessing too much about your health or work, it could be causing too much stress, and it's time to recalibrate and refocus your awareness. Your intention for this New Moon is to tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. When you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind and prioritize your own health and well-being, you'll find that opportunities open up and your overall health improves. Remember to focus on your own needs and to create a self-care regimen that helps you feel grounded and energized. This will allow you to better serve others and to move forward with confidence and clarity. In this stage of your journey, you may be asked to be more attentive to details and to consider how you give too much of yourself, leaving you feeling drained and underappreciated. The new moon in the 6th house can teach you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals is essential for your overall health and wellness. Remember to focus on taking care of yourself and to be mindful of your own needs. This might include establishing a self-care routine or setting small, achievable goals that help you to feel grounded and energized.

The Libra new moon is in your 5th House of Fun, Children, and Creativity. During the New Moon in Libra, love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression may be at the forefront of your mind. This is a time to consider how you identify with these areas of your life and how they shape you. It's important to think about how you express yourself and how it's being received by others. Are you abandoning a part of yourself in order to receive love and validation? You may be feeling intense emotions about your worth and value, which could lead to temporary emotional conflict. One way to lift your mood during this time is to return to an old hobby or joyful pastime. It's important for you to stay connected to what you love and to have fun and enjoy yourself. Let yourself play and remember what it's like to be a child with curiosity. Nurturing your inner child can help you to cultivate self-love and love for others. This is a time to let go of any self-doubt or insecurity and embrace your unique talents and gifts. Close your eyes and visualize your inner creative fire like a flame, pulsing with vibrant energy and infinite possibilities. Allow yourself to become a channel for this creative force, and let your work radiate through you rather than simply being created by you. Trust in your ability to tap into this boundless source of inspiration and let it guide you. Embrace your humor, charisma, and optimism, and set an intention to magnetize love and new opportunities for connection into your life. Let your inner light shine brightly and trust in your ability to create and attract abundance. The new moon in Libra, in the fifth house, is a time of new beginnings and a chance to tap into your inner strength and creativity. Embrace your unique talents and let your light shine. The world is waiting for your unique spark to ignite and bring new and exciting possibilities into being. Your intention for this New Moon is to discover your inner child and nurture them in all the ways they wish. This will allow true self-love and love of others to unfold naturally. Remember to take care of yourself and to stay connected to what brings you joy and fulfillment.

The Libra new moon activates your 4th house of home and family. As the New Moon in Libra illuminates your 4th house, it brings to light the emotional foundations of your life. You may be feeling the urge to make changes to your living space, whether that means moving, redecorating or simply decluttering. This is an opportunity to create a sanctuary that brings you peace and contentment. It's also a time to reflect on the emotional ties that bind you to your family, loved ones, and your sense of home. Use this energy to cultivate deeper connections and a sense of belonging. The Libra new moon encourages you to create meaningful moments in your home. You could invite friends over for a cozy dinner party, rearrange your furniture to create fresh, new energy, or give your living space a splash of color with a fresh coat of paint. It doesn't have to be a grand gesture - it just needs to be something that feels special and significant. This is a great time to invest in your home and make new memories with the people you care about most. You might also notice changes in your home and family situation during this time, or you may be evaluating what brings you comfort and security. This could be both emotional security and physical security. It's possible that your family may need more from you than usual, which could bring up old wounds but also allow you to heal and move beyond old limitations. Take this opportunity to consider how your family fits into your future and how you can work towards cultivating deeper, healthier connections. Your home is like a chariot, a safe and secure container that transports you and your belongings from one life event to another. It's important to have a strong foundation and a sense of belonging in order to navigate life successfully. This is a time to be proactive and to make conscious choices that align with your goals and values. Trust in your own strength and determination, and remember that you are the driver of your own life. The new moon in the fourth house is a time of new beginnings and a chance to take charge of your own path. Overall, the New Moon in Libra is a time to focus on your inner home and to find your sense of safety and security within yourself. This is where your power lies, and it's a great time to explore your emotional process and to create special moments in your home. Remember to take care of yourself and to invest in the people and things that bring you joy and comfort. As the night wears on and the moon continues to rise, you may find yourself feeling more connected to yourself and to those around you, nourished by the warmth and comfort of your own home. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To come back to your inner home and internal sense of safety and security. Here is where your power lies.”

The Libra new moon activates your 3rd House of communication, early education, processing information, community, siblings, and neighbors. The new moon in Libra also brings with it a strong sense of passion and excitement for your ideas and concepts. You may find yourself feeling particularly energized and enthusiastic about sharing information and knowledge with others. This could manifest in various ways such as starting a blog, leading a workshop, or taking on a mentor role. Embrace this energy and use it to connect with others, share your ideas and knowledge, and inspire others to do the same. Remember to be open-minded to others’ ideas and perspectives, and to seek out feedback and input to further refine and develop your own ideas. The new moon in Libra is a powerful time to bring new ideas to life. rows.body: Opposites who can fully see each other, both observant, detail-oriented givers. Pisces sets the mood and helps by expansion and teaching (Jupiterian); Virgo makes the plans and helps by reduction and efficiency (Mercurial). They complement each other, but the real friction is their sameness: both give first and struggle to receive. It works when each learns to take, not just give.

On the surface alike (both sweet, social, Venus-dignified, secretly anxious). The key difference: Libra exalts Saturn and is the king of boundaries, selective and needing at least a week to know a feeling; Pisces is a quantum feeler who guesses your emotions too soon. It works when Pisces stops rushing Libra and Libra lets Pisces theorize.

A deep water bond; both slow down and investigate every moment of friction. Scorpio unravels the mystery; Pisces is entertained by it and can change the truth mid-sentence. Best friends who read each other almost telepathically.

Both are Mercury's detriment, so miscommunication is strong; both hear what they want to hear. But both dignify Jupiter, so they take each other in good faith and believe the best. It works not through perfect communication but through mutual generosity of interpretation.
